Priya: quick sync - thinking about autosnapshot + autopause heuristics for runtime flag rollouts. want constraints and owners.
Diego: autosnapshot = take immutable config snapshot on commit so rollback is one-click, correct?
Priya: yes. and an autopause heuristic that fires when combined quota delta + latency delta crosses safety bounds.
Sam: propose heuristic: estimated token burn delta >= 30% AND p95 latency delta >= 20% sustained for 2 consecutive 2m windows => create snapshot + mark paused.
Nate: we must ignore warmup noise. exclude first 8 minutes after commit unless cohort >= 10%.
Diego: where to run detectors? proxy emits low-latency signals but central detector service is easier to maintain. prefer central.
Sam: agree. central service subscribes metrics stream + config feed and writes rollout_events rows.
Priya: pause semantics: default to drain (stop new cohort allocations, let in-flight finish). also require operator TTL override (default 20m) for force-unpause.
Nate: telemetry: tag events with rollout.id, commit, cohort_pct, est_token_delta, p95_delta_ms, trigger_reason.
Sam: API sketch: POST /api/v1/rollouts/{id}/action {"action":"pause","mode":"drain","reason":"autosnap-trigger"} returns 202 + job_id.
Priya: console: add an autosnap card with snapshot button, rollback button (shows diff + preview), and a big Pause toggle with confirmation modal and runbook link.
Diego: test plan: 72h shadow write to rollout_events, then autosnapshot in non-blocking mode for 24h, then full in staging with synthetic spike.
ops-bot: runbook draft created: rollout_autosnap_v1. Slack channel #rollout-autosnap created. Link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollout_autosnap_v1 :white_check_mark:
Priya: owners: Priya product rules, Sam pause API, Diego telemetry + estimator, Nate staging tests. timeline: shadow by Fri, UI mock next Tue, autopause toggle after staging pass.
Sam: one more: gate autopause to rollouts with cohort >= 1% to avoid tiny canaries.
Priya: noted. leaving thread, ping owners if blockers. :rocket:
